marketing.title: Your digital business card
marketing.subtitle: Create your card, share it with a tap, and follow up with everyone you meet.
marketing.headline: Your professional card, with nothing to run out of.
marketing.lede: Build one card, share it by QR, NFC tag or link, and see exactly who opened it and who got in touch.
marketing.proof: Works in Arabic and English, and updates for everyone holding your link the moment you edit it.

card.title: A card that updates after you share it
card.body: Change your number or title once and everyone holding your link sees it. The link itself never changes.

capture.title: Contact capture
capture.body: The “share your details” form turns a visitor into a consented contact record, ready to export or sync to your CRM.

presence.title: Presence at every touchpoint
presence.body: QR code, email signature, meeting background, NFC tag and wallet pass all point at the same card and are measured apart.

analytics.title: Analytics that separate touchpoints
analytics.body: See how many visits came from the tag versus the signature, and which link people actually tap.

team.title: One identity across the team
team.body: Lock the logo, colour and title format at company level; leave each employee only what is theirs.

events.title: Events and expos
events.body: Scan paper cards with the camera, add qualifying questions, and get an event report when it closes.

steps.title: Three steps to your first contact

one.title: Build the card
one.body: Name, title, links. Pick a template and colour, and preview as you type.

two.title: Publish and share
two.body: Publishing fixes the link and generates the QR code, vCard and wallet pass.

three.title: Follow who reached out
three.body: Every visit, tap and contact lands on your dashboard, split by touchpoint.

signature.backgroundsIntro: A 1920x1080 background built from the same card, for Zoom, Teams and Meet.

events.title: Events
events.intro: An event has a time window and dedicated cards. Every capture through them inside the window is attributed to it automatically.
events.name: Event name
events.cardsHint: Captures through these cards inside the window are attributed to the event without the rep choosing anything.
events.qualifiersHint: Filled standing in a hall — six fields at most, and fewer means more of them actually get filled.

scan.title: Card scanning
scan.intro: Photograph a paper card or a badge, review what was extracted, then save it as a contact.
scan.captureHint: The image is read automatically then deleted. We do not keep a photo of someone's card after extracting its fields.
scan.manualOnly: No recognition engine is configured: fields appear empty for manual entry, and the image is deleted all the same.
scan.marketingConsentHint: Handing over a card is a basis for professional contact only. Tick this only if they agreed explicitly.
scan.duplicate: Saved and flagged as a duplicate of an earlier contact.
scan.planLimit: Card scanning is not included in your current plan.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.intro: The channels your organisation's data leaves through: an API key, Webhook endpoints and a CRM connection.
integrations.keysIntro: A key represents a system, not a person: it does not end with a sign-out, and only revoking it here stops it.
integrations.revokeConfirm: Revoke this key? Every system using it stops immediately.
integrations.secretOnce: Shown once only — copy it now, nothing returns it later.
integrations.webhooksIntro: A signed call to your system the moment an event happens. Every delivery carries a signature, a timestamp and an event id.
integrations.crmIntro: One-way sync into your system, without duplicates, with a log for every operation and retries for what failed.
integrations.accessTokenHint: Stays on the server and is never shown after saving. Leave empty if you are only editing the mapping.
integrations.marketingOnly: Sync only those who consented to marketing
integrations.marketingOnlyHint: Anyone who did not grant marketing consent never leaves for a marketing system, and stays flagged with the reason.
integrations.planLimit: This feature is not included in your current plan.
